protocols.science_program: ASI direct_llm-style single-turn complete Python generation

supervision: All 102 official human reference Python programs; single-turn ASI direct_llm format; no synthetic tool observations or hidden reasoning
selection: Include all 102 tasks; no task-runtime, dependency, CPU/GPU, or local execution gate. Exclude only confirmed overlap with the four formal evaluation task sets.
verification: Publisher verified references; tasks 5 and 92 passed local native checkers. Local reruns are optional evidence, not an SFT admission requirement.
sampling: One pass, no duplication to reach a target task count
mixed_control: Use the same SAB training rows once in the Mixed control
attribution: Retain original source, license, and canary. Six tasks retain their upstream licenses; do not label every task CC BY 4.0. Do not redistribute the raw benchmark bundle.
